description: This file defines a Flutter login screen widget with state management, including username/password validation, persistence of last username, and navigation upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the login screen, including UI elements for username/password input and login button.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI state for LoginScreen, including text controllers, validation, persistence, and navigation logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and attempts to restore last username from preferences.

methods.name: _restoreLastUsername
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves last username from preferences and populates the username field.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text editing controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles login submission, validates inputs, updates preferences, and triggers navigation upon success.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the login UI and handles navigation to calculator screen if login is successful.
